title: Best Character Creator Apps for Making Your Own Original Character (2026)
summary: Compare the best character creator apps for iPhone and Android. Design an original character from scratch, then give them a personality, a backstory and a life.
body_markdown:
A good character creator app should help you make something that’s **yours** : a face nobody else has, a personality, a backstory and somewhere for the character to exist. This guide is about building original characters from scratch, not recreating someone else’s.


Below we sort the best character creator apps by what they’re actually good at, show the verified price on each store, and link to deeper guides for each type.


*Redbean is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by any of the apps or companies named here. App names are trademarks of their owners. No official artwork is used on this page.*


Table of Contents


Toggle


##


Quick answer


#


- **Fast portrait or profile picture:** Picrew or Dollify
- **Full character plus scenes and stories:** Gacha Life 2 or Gacha Club
- **3D avatar you can pose and photograph:** VRoid Mobile or ZEPETO
- **Outfits and style:** Everskies or Pocket Love!
- **Characters who live in a world:** Avatar World, Toca Boca World, or Redbean


Store details checked on the US App Store and Google Play on October 24, 2026. Prices and labels can change, so check the listing before you download.


##


What a character creator app actually does


#


Most apps cover one or two of these four stages. Few cover all of them.


1. **Look.** Face, hair, body, colors, outfit. Almost every app does this.
2. **Personality.** Traits, likes, quirks, voice. This is rarer, and you often have to write it yourself.
3. **Backstory.** Where they came from and what they want. Usually done in notes, a[character sheet](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/oc-template/) , or a story or scene mode.
4. **Life.** Putting the character somewhere they can act, meet others and change.


If you’re starting from nothing, read[how to make your own character from scratch](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/make-your-own-character/) first, then pick the app that fits the stage you care about most.

##


Picks by type


#


###


Portrait makers: start with a face


#


Picrew’s App Store listing describes 10,000+ image makers from creators worldwide, and you can download or share what you make for free. Dollify builds portrait avatars from item categories. Both are great for a first look before you commit to a design. **More:**[apps like Picrew](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/apps-like-picrew/) .


###


Gacha-style creators: character plus scenes


#


Gacha Life 2 and Gacha Club let you design full-body characters, then pose them in a Studio with backgrounds to tell stories. **More:**[games like Gacha Life](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/games-like-gacha-life/) .


###


Avatar makers: a character you can use everywhere


#


VRoid Mobile (3D, adjustable with sliders), ZEPETO (3D plus social worlds) and Bitmoji (a cartoon version of you for chats). **More:**[avatar maker apps](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/avatar-maker-app/) .


###


Dress-up apps: style as personality


#


What a character wears says a lot about who they are. Everskies and Pocket Love! focus on your own character’s look. **More:**[dress up game apps](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/dress-up-games-app/) .


###


Free options


#


Every app in the table is free to download, but several list ads or in-app purchases. **More:**[free character creator options](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/free-character-creator/) .


##


How to choose


#


- **Decide which stage matters most:** look, personality, story or life.
- **Check the labels.** “Contains ads” and “In-app purchases” are shown on each Google Play listing.
- **Check the age rating.** Ratings vary widely, from 4+ to 17+ on the App Store.
- **Check export and use rights** if you plan to post or reuse the art. Some image makers set their own rules.
- **Keep a character sheet** outside the app so your character survives if you switch tools ([free OC template](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/oc-template/) ).


##


Best OC maker apps?


#


“OC” just means original character. If you want a step-by-step on designing one, our[OC maker guide](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/oc-maker/) covers it. This page is about choosing the app.


##


Where Redbean fits


#


Most creators stop at the picture. Redbean is free to download. Its App Store listing describes it as a place where your original characters live in a town together, build relationships, visit places, react to events and create stories. It suits the “life” stage: designing a character and then seeing what they do.


##


FAQ


#


**What is the best character creator app?**
It depends on the stage: Picrew or Dollify for portraits, Gacha Life 2 for scenes, VRoid Mobile for 3D, and Redbean or Avatar World for characters in a world.


**Are character creator apps free?**
All the apps listed here are free to download on both stores. Several show ads or in-app purchases on Google Play.


**Can I make a character with a personality and backstory?**
Most apps only handle looks. Write personality and backstory in a character sheet, or use an app where characters can interact.
